transfer.prompt: An AI agent can approve customer refunds. Where would you add an independent check before money is sent, and why?
transfer.answer: I'd put a separate check before the refund is sent, because the same agent that made the decision can miss its own mistake. If the check fails, the refund is blocked and sent back to be fixed.
transfer.feedback: You placed the gate at the right point — before money moves — and used an independent checker rather than self-grading, with a failed verdict routed back for a fix. Clear and complete.
